notes: Fixes what Crisp tells you when it cannot activate a licence. If our licence server was slow to answer, Crisp used to wait, ask a second server that has never issued a Crisp key, and then tell you it could not decide whether your key was wrong or your connection was — after about twelve seconds. It now asks the one server that sold you your key, answers in under a second, and if that server is unreachable it says so plainly instead of blaming your key. Crisp is also more careful about retrying: it will only try again where trying again cannot use up one of your activations. If you bought Crisp and cannot activate it, email support@crispvideo.app and we will sort it out.
